title: Scripts metadata: startup command, parameters, order, and PowerShell ordering
blocked_reason: repeatable R10 scripts metadata lane qualification is pending

provenance.note: R2 banked native Scripts CSE INI captures establish the UTF-16LE/CRLF wire bytes and PowerShell ordering; a repeatable R10 Import-GPO/report/Backup-GPO lane must qualify the end-to-end metadata round trip.

anchors.note: Banked native PowerShell scripts.ini capture with RunPSFirst ordering.

derivations: Native legacy scripts.ini is UTF-16LE with BOM and CRLF and carries the two command entries with their parameter positions.
Native psscripts.ini carries StartExecutePSFirst=true and the PowerShell startup entry.
This scenario asserts metadata import/render/rebackup only; script payload execution and endpoint policy processing are outside scope.

open_questions: Does Import-GPO render all three entries in the GPMC report with exact command, optionalParameters, Type, Order, and RunOrder fields?
Does Backup-GPO preserve the INI bytes and CSE references after import?
Are absent executable payload files tolerated by metadata import, and does endpoint processing require them?
